records.name: American Indian Council on Alcoholism, Inc.
records.what: An Urban Indian Organization funded by the Indian Health Service. The Indian Health Service lists it as offering outpatient treatment for alcohol and drug use.
records.who: American Indian and Alaska Native people living in or near the city. Ask what proof of tribal affiliation or descent it needs.
